asks.ask: An issue labeled `hotfix` skips planning and plan review.
By hand, the owner's `/work` starts a hotfix's worker.
When its turn comes (by hand, or on autopilot once nothing open blocks it), the worker builds straight from the issue's text
the text is the whole ask.
Code review still runs and judges the diff against the issue's text
All tests and the merge gate still run, as for any pull request.
The worker may add or change a small test that pins the fix
When code review finds the change bigger than the ask
it goes back to normal planning, saying why.
keep the prompts free of anything about Dokima's own repo, so they fit any repo.
